title: Colorado Springs Is The Newest Site For Nike Running Camp
htmlContent:
Experienced coaching staff and a variety of magnificent running trails highlight this new Nike Cross Country Camp at University of Colorado, Colorado Springs.

“The trails in the surrounding area of Colorado Springs are magnificent,” says Jan O’Connor Executive Vice President at US Sports Camps. "With nature preserves such as Garden of the Gods, Bear Creek Park, and Gold Camp Road runners get the privilege to run beautiful trails in a high-altitude environment with top notch coaching.”

Endurance athletes competitors that prepare in the U.S. often prepare in high height. Sprinters can hope to significantly enhance their endurance and running stamina at camp. The camp is offered July eighteenth July 21st, 2018 at the University of Colorado, Colorado Springs. The camp is co-ed and open to campers ages 12-18. Camp coaches Sara Kettelkamp and Corey Kubatzky are determined to provide the best possible experience for campers this summer.  For more data look at the Colorado Springs site.

Campers, Parents, and Coaches interested in receiving more information regarding the 2018 Nike Soccer Camps can visit our website at http://www.ussportscamps.com/running or call at 1-800-645-3226.

About US Sports Camps

US Sports Camps (USSC), headquartered in San Rafael, California, is America's largest sports camp network and the licensed operator of Nike Sports Camps. The company has offered summer camps since 1975 with the same mission that defines it today: to shape a lifelong enjoyment of athletics through high quality sports education and skill enhancement.
